purpose: Infer each acquisition run's nominal-label-zero QR tracking regions from nonzero images only

sources.data_root: C:\Users\SSAFY\Desktop\[기업연계_세메스] 교보재\[기업연계_세메스] 교보재\SSAFY Test Image Set

method.registration: Reuse original per-QR ZNCC-initialized affine ECC measurements; no new raw-image registration
method.coordinate_convention: original 3840x2160 pixel coordinates, origin at top-left pixel center, x right/y down
method.primary_model: For each marker in each chronological run, independently fit position(q) = intercept + slope*q by unweighted least squares; evaluate at q=0
method.region_model: Apply each saved affine linear part and measured center displacement to the existing ROI's four corner pixel centers; extrapolate corners at q=0
method.time_used_for: run grouping and order, not a time-to-position model
method.sensitivity_check: Quadratic fits on the same samples; compare q=0 predictions, without choosing a model by in-sample residual or assigning probabilities

limitations: These are extrapolated nominal-zero candidates for separate runs, not an identified true mechanical zero or a calibrated probability region.
Labels are nominal; the other axis and return-to-zero state are unverified. No common origin is imposed across runs.
Only differences determine slopes; the filename-label origin supplies q=0. An unknown shift of that origin cannot be recovered from increments alone.
The three ROIs are existing tracking patches including margins, not newly detected exact QR code boundaries or QR geometric centers.
center.bmp supplies a coordinate/template anchor, but its displacement is not included as a zero-valued fit sample.
The primary model assumes approximately linear image response within each run. Quadratic sensitivity does not establish which model is physically correct.
Candidate min-max ranges across six runs are not confidence intervals or acceptance criteria. Small in-sample residuals do not prove absolute accuracy.
